about: HTTP calls from code (DESIGN 5.23): every runtime starts the test server below on a free port of 127.0.0.1, makes each call against it, and gives the reply the case names. A path is called on that server; a url is called as it is. The reply's status is 0 when no answer came, ok is true for a status from 200 to 299, and text is what the server answered, or why no answer came. A case with text_starts checks only the start of the text, which goes on with the system's own reason. A case with base calls its path at that address, as `http get "/orders" from shop` calls the source's (the server's own address stands for it, written {server}); its query parameters are added in order, each name and value percent-encoded (only letters, digits and - . _ ~ stay as they are); its auth is the source's: bearer sends `Authorization: Bearer <secret>`, api-key `X-Api-Key: <secret>`, basic `Authorization: Basic <base64 of the secret>`, where the secret is read from the environment variable env names. The test sets env before the calls. A case with paging reads every page (DESIGN 5.23, paging): kind page sends param = 1, 2, ... and size_param = size; offset sends param = 0, size, 2*size, ... and size_param = size; cursor sends no param first, then param = the text at next in the page before (a number as its digits); link calls the address the Link header names rel="next". Items are a page's JSON list, or the list at items (a path as read's at). It stops at a page with fewer items than size (page, offset), without a next cursor (missing, null or "") or without a next link, and after 1000 pages: status 0, ok false, text "stopped after 1000 pages of <path>". The reply's text is one JSON list of every item, in order, written compactly; its status is the last page's. A page that is not ok is the reply. A page without a list where items says gives status 0, ok false and "page N of <path> has no list at <items>" ("at the top" without items).

server.about: Answers with status and text as each route says, as text/plain in UTF-8.

routes.text: the request's method, a space and its body
the value of the request's header X-Test
the request's query, as it came, without the ?
the request's Authorization header, or its X-Api-Key header when it has no Authorization
the numbers from (page - 1) * size + 1 up to page * size and at most 5, as a JSON list, for the query's page and size
{"data": the numbers from offset + 1 up to offset + limit and at most 5}, for the query's offset and limit
{"data": [after + 1, after + 2], at most 5, "meta": {"next": the text of after + 2, or null when that reaches 5}}, after being the query's after, 0 without it
the numbers (page - 1) * 2 + 1 and the next, at most 5, as a JSON list, for the query's page (1 without it); while more follow, the header Link: <{server}/linked?page=page + 1>; rel="next"
[1,2] for the query's page 1; for any other page status 500 and the text down
[the query's page], as a JSON list, for every page
